title: ATDD Commit Trailer Group
description: The structured trailer group that makes git history a reliable event log (doc section 5). Free prose is insufficient. Raw tokens, bearer tokens, secrets or credentials are INVALID (rule 5, I8).

ATDD-Gate.description: Rule 3: gate evidence id, e.g. E019.

ATDD-Object.description: Rule 1: a projection object diff MUST carry this.

ATDD-Projection-Digest.description: Rule 4: MUST match the generated projection digest.

ATDD-Token-Digest.description: Rule 3, gated transitions. Digest only, never the token.

ATDD-Transition.description: Rule 2: a phase diff MUST carry this.

commit_kind.description: Selects the cardinality rule below (section 5 rules 6-7).

groups.description: Repeated trailer groups, one per changed projection object (multi_object).
